visualCharacteristics.description: Third-party interactive embed; an author cannot type it, so it is an embed block holding the Ceros URL. Ceros Studio (*.ceros.site) experiences load through the Ceros embed SDK (auto height); classic view.ceros.com experiences load as a fixed-ratio iframe with the Ceros scroll proxy.

contentPattern.description: Ceros interactive ETF promo banner iframe (title 'etf banner for homepage IND')
contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: optional poster image, then a link to the Ceros experience URL
rows: Optional poster image; link to https://<account>.ceros.site/<experience> or https://view.ceros.com/<account>/<experience>

usage: Promo banners or interactive stories built in Ceros and embedded on a page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any Ceros-hosted experience (*.ceros.site, view.ceros.com or other *.ceros.com URLs). For YouTube/Vimeo or other providers use a generic embed block instead. The link text (if not a URL) becomes the iframe title for accessibility.
